A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Meat Yellowness (b* value)

1 Loading packages and data

## Load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for meat yellowness (b*)
data_B <- read.csv("B.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_B$Mean <- as.numeric(data_B$Mean)
data_B$SD <- as.numeric(data_B$SD)
data_B$Sample <- as.numeric(data_B$Sample)
data_B$Age <- as.numeric(data_B$Age)
data_B$Weight <- as.numeric(data_B$Weight)
data_B$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_B$Digestible_energy)
data_B$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_B$Crude_protein)
data_B$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_B$Crude_fat)
data_B$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_B$Crude_fiber)
data_B$Ash <- as.numeric(data_B$Ash)
data_B$Lys <- as.numeric(data_B$Lys)
data_B$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_B$Met_and_Cys)
data_B$Thr <- as.numeric(data_B$Thr)
data_B$Try <- as.numeric(data_B$Try)
data_B$Val <- as.numeric(data_B$Val)
data_B$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_B$Dry_matter)
data_B$Ca <- as.numeric(data_B$Ca)
data_B$P <- as.numeric(data_B$P)
data_B$Na <- as.numeric(data_B$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_B$Position <- factor(data_B$Position)
data_B$Breed <- factor(data_B$Breed)
data_B$Class <- factor(data_B$Class)
data_B$Sex <- factor(data_B$Sex)
data_B$Region <- factor(data_B$Region)
data_B$Aim <- factor(data_B$Aim)
data_B$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_B$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_B$rVar <- (data_B$SD/sqrt(data_B$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_B_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_B, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_B_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_B, method = "ML")
summary(null_B_mod) #2118.7457        
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 468; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1056.3728   2626.0293   2118.7457   2131.1911   2118.7974   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  1.3226  1.1500    468     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  9.1307  3.0217    256     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 467) = 248740.4902, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   5.4059  0.2007  26.9335  <.0001  5.0125  5.7993  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_B_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_B, method = "ML")
summary(Re_B_mod) #2102.0516               
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 468; method: ML)
##

## 
## Variance Components:
##

## sigma^2.2  8.3077  2.8823    256     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.7627  1.3277     46     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 467) = 248740.4902, p-val < .0001

##

                     random = list(~1 |RowID,

                                   ~1 |Position),
                     sparse = TRUE,
                     data = data_B, method = "ML")

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
B_full_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_B, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(B_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(B_full_mod,null_B_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik      LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    145 2136.5280 2738.0559 2268.0187  -923.2640                  32717.5446 
## Reduced   3 2118.7457 2131.1911 2118.7974 -1056.3728 266.2176 <.0001 248740.4902
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
B_Position_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_B, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(B_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(B_Position_mod,null_B_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik     LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    17 2103.2115 2173.7355 2104.5715 -1034.6058                205363.2279 
## Reduced  3 2118.7457 2131.1911 2118.7974 -1056.3728 43.5341 <.0001 248740.4902
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
B_Breed_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Breed,
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_B, method = "ML")
R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(B_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(B_Breed_mod,null_B_mod)

## Model with Region as a fixed effect
B_Region_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(B_Region_mod)*100, 2)
anova(B_Region_mod,null_B_mod)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
B_Class_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData,

                       random = list(~1 |RowID,

                       sparse = TRUE,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(B_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(B_Class_mod,null_B_mod)
##

## Reduced  3 2118.7457 2131.1911 2118.7974 -1056.3728 47.6357 <.0001 248740.4902
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region",
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1],
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_B_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_B_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,
                                      ~1 |Breed,
                                      ~1 |Position),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_B, method = "REML")
summary(REML_B_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 468; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1029.9575   2059.9149   2071.9149   2096.7929   2072.0976   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.8282  0.9101    468     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  8.6285  2.9374    256     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.9289  1.3889     46     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2480  0.4980     85     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  1.1057  1.0515     15     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 467) = 248740.4902, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   5.8001  0.4879  11.8879  <.0001  4.8439  6.7564  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values 
round(i2_ml(REML_B_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID   I2_Region    I2_Breed I2_Position 
##       99.94        6.50       67.69       15.13        1.95        8.67
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_B_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##            0.0           93.5
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_B <- orchard_plot(REML_B_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Meat Yellowness (b*)",
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)

print(p_REML_B)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_B_B3 <- data_B %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_B_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_B_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region,
                               ~1 |Position)

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_B_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_B_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_B_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_B_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 341; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc

# Model without intercept for plotting
Br_VCV_REML_B_mod <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_B_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed -1,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_B_B3)
## Orchard plot for Breed moderator
p_Br_VCV_REML_B <- orchard_plot(Br_VCV_REML_B_mod, 
                                  mod = "Breed",  
                                  group = "StudyID",  
                                  xlab = "Mean Meat Yellowness (b*)",
                                  cb = FALSE,
                                  angle = 0,
                                  legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                  branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Br_VCV_REML_B)

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Breed using all_models function
res_B_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_B_B3,
  vcv         = VCV_B_B3_Data,
  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Breed",
  random_list = random_structure_breed 
)

3.2 Class

## Filter data for Class with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_B_Cl <- data_B %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered Class data

                                   cluster = "StudyID",

## Define random structure
random_structure_class <- list(~1 |RowID,

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_B_Age <- data_B[complete.cases(data_B$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_B_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_B_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Region,  
                                    ~1 |Breed, 
                                    ~1 |Position)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_B_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_B_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_B_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Meat Yellowness (b* value)" 
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_B_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_B_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_B_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_B_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_age)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed, 
                            ~1 |Position)

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_B_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_B_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_B)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_B_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 468; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1021.9868   2043.9735   2057.9735   2086.9828   2058.2181   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.8238  0.9076    468     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  8.1853  2.8610    256     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  2.1706  1.4733     46     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2494  0.4994     85     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  1.0839  1.0411     15     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 466) = 235416.5478, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 466) = 11.4900, p-val = 0.0008
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##           estimate        se     tval   df    pval      ci.lb      ci.ub      
## intrcpt  -470.5904  140.5417  -3.3484  466  0.0009  -746.7644  -194.4164  *** 
## Years       0.2359    0.0696   3.3897  466  0.0008     0.0992     0.3727  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_B_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           3.53          93.65
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_B <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_B_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Meat Yellowness (b*)", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_B <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_B + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_B)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## Define random structure
random_structure_aim <- list(~1 |RowID,
                             ~1 |StudyID,
                             ~1 |Region,  
                             ~1 |Breed,
                             ~1 |Position)

#Model with intercept
Ai_VCV_REML_B_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_B_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_B)
summary(Ai_VCV_REML_B_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 468; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1027.4627   2054.9253   2068.9253   2097.9346   2069.1699   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.8277  0.9098    468     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  8.6705  2.9446    256     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.9291  1.3889     46     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2480  0.4980     85     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  1.1076  1.0524     15     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 466) = 245475.4244, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 466) = 0.0641, p-val = 0.8002
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se     tval   df    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub      
## intrcpt    5.8891  0.6011   9.7976  466  <.0001   4.7080  7.0703  *** 
## AimYes    -0.1253  0.4949  -0.2533  466  0.8002  -1.0978  0.8471      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ai_VCV_REML_B_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.02          93.53
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_B_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_B_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_B)
## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
p_Ai_VCV_REML_B <- orchard_plot(Ai_VCV_REML_B_mod, 
                                   mod = "Aim",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Meat Yellowness (b*)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Ai_VCV_REML_B)

4.3 Multiple_breeds (Whether multiple breeds were involved)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Mu <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed,
                            ~1 |Position)

#Model with intercept
Mu_VCV_REML_B_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_B_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds,
   random = random_structure_Mu, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_B)
summary(Mu_VCV_REML_B_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 468; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1027.3062   2054.6123   2068.6123   2097.6216   2068.8569   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.8279  0.9099    468     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  8.6673  2.9440    256     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.9394  1.3926     46     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2489  0.4989     85     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  1.1058  1.0516     15     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 466) = 222203.3525, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 466) = 0.0210, p-val = 0.8848
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##                     estimate      se     tval   df    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub      
## intrcpt               5.7875  0.4962  11.6631  466  <.0001   4.8124  6.7626  *** 
## Multiple_breedsYes    0.0903  0.6227   0.1449  466  0.8848  -1.1335  1.3140      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Mu_VCV_REML_B_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.01          93.53
#Model without intercept for plotting
Mu_VCV_REML_B_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_B_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds -1,
   random = random_structure_Mu, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_B)
## Orchard plot for Multiple_breeds moderator
p_Mu_VCV_REML_B <- orchard_plot(Mu_VCV_REML_B_mod, 
                                   mod = "Multiple_breeds",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Meat Yellowness (b*)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Mu_VCV_REML_B)
